         SEGMENT K13/K51 LANDOWNERS’ NOTICE OF CORRECTIONS TO
                         ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30
        On June 5, 2026, the Administrative Law Judges (“ALJs”) filed SOAH Order No. 30,

including Attachment A, which is a list of exhibits the ALJs “expect to admit that were uploaded

into Kiteworks and constitute either (1) direct, rebuttal, or cross-rebuttal testimony that was

prefiled as required by previous orders, subject to any rulings that have been made to objections;

and (2) discovery responses that were filed in this proceeding.” At the prehearing conference on

June 5, 2026, the ALJs directed the parties to file corrections to Attachment A on the PUC

Interchange in this proceeding.

        Attachment A includes Segment K13/K51 Landowners (identified as party no. 551)

Exhibits 1-20. Segment K13/K51 Landowners intend to offer Exhibits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9,

and 20, which meet the criteria stated above. Segment K13/K51 Landowners do not intend to

offer Exhibits 10, 11, 12, 12A, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 19 at this time, but may offer them during

the hearing for the purposes of cross-examination.


Segment K13/K51 Notice of Corrections to Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30

         In accordance with the ALJs' directions at the prehearing conference, Segment K13/K51

Landowners hereby respectfully request that the ALJs correct Attachment A to remove their

Exhibits 10, 11, 12, 12A, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 19 from the admitted exhibits list at this time.
